payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully

condition.question: Compared with SOURCE, is her jacket fully closed in EDITED?
condition.criteria: Compare the same jacket on the woman in SOURCE and EDITED. Assess whether the front panels have moved together toward closure; full achievement requires the panels to meet so no visible opening remains along the closure.
condition.binding: Compare the jacket on the woman in SOURCE with the jacket on the woman in EDITED; judge progress toward the requested endpoint of a fully closed jacket, distinguishing no visible progress, concrete partial closure, and full closure.
condition.endpoint: Her jacket is fully closed, with no visible opening along the closure.
condition.necessity: This is the requested change and its complete endpoint.
condition.zero_when: The same jacket shows no visible movement of its front panels toward one another compared with SOURCE; it remains equally open or more open.
condition.half_when: The front panels show concrete movement toward one another compared with SOURCE, but a visible opening remains along the closure; this is incomplete progress, not full closure.
condition.full_when: The front panels meet and no visible opening remains along the jacket closure.
